title: CROSS-ARCHITECTURE MODEL DIFFING WITH CROSSCODERS: UNSUPERVISED DISCOVERY OF DIFFERENCES BETWEEN LLMS
reasoning: The paper investigates and evaluates the ideological and ethical 'diffs' between models, specifically looking at political alignment (CCP alignment vs. American exceptionalism), safety training (copyright refusal), and various categories of harmful content (e.g., hate speech, discrimination, and misinformation) that models are aligned to avoid or exhibit.
